name: Tempi API
description: Scheduling API. Public operations let anyone, including AI assistants, look up open times and book a meeting. Account operations need an API key (`Authorization: Bearer bk_...`) from Settings → API keys in the web app. Times are ISO 8601 and returned in UTC. A `timezone` input sets how dates are read and how slots are grouped by day.
